props.name: items
props.description: The feed, as data: {id, title, description?, time?, icon?, read?, group?, onClick?}. Read and unread are yours — the panel is presentational. So is the order: groups are formed in order of first appearance and never re-sorted.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Fires for every item. An item that has neither this nor its own onClick renders as a <div>, not a button — nothing that does nothing is focusable.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Draws the mark-all action, and only while something is unread.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger and of the panel. The unread count is appended to the trigger's name, so it is heard and not only seen.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side the panel opens on. It flips on its own when there is no room.
